_about: T632 (owner 2026-11-11): tidal water is subtracted from every DFO place the reach run places, unless the place is listed here with a stated reason. One row per place: {"<location_id>": {"reason": "why this place keeps its tidal water", "by": "owner", "on": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}. Authored by hand (owner); read by pipeline.atlas.reach.dfo_salmon.load_tidal_calls (reach run). A row with no reason, or naming no place, stops the run. A place the subtraction would leave with no water stops the run until it is marked tidal water (T449) or listed here.
